versions.changelog:
- Initial release of godfery-reminder: a lightweight natural-language reminder secretary for SkillBoss.
- Capture events (meetings, birthdays, deadlines) from chat in Chinese or English.
- Save structured event data to your workspace for easy sync and backup via Git or claw-roam.
- Schedule Telegram notifications using SkillBoss cron with configurable reminder offsets (default 24h/1h/10m).
- Respond to queries about upcoming plans and events.
- Supports timezone and notification offset configuration; parses events using the SkillBoss API Hub.
